intro.purpose: Explain shared accounts and the account host's role

signin.purpose: Collect a full handle or DID for an existing account

providers.purpose: Choose an enabled, allowed signup host

error.purpose: Offer recovery using a public error key

signin.input: A normalized full handle or AT Protocol DID

signup.input: An HTTPS PDS or entryway address

state.busy: Whether an authorization operation is in progress
state.identifier: Last submitted identifier, preserved for validation and retry
state.error: A public error key or no error
state.result: An opaque platform-local adapter result; never part of a wire format

requirements.busy: Block navigation and duplicate authorization attempts until the current operation completes
requirements.success: Only a verified adapter result completes the flow; redirects and popup handoffs remain pending
requirements.providerAllowlist: Omitted means all enabled signup hosts; empty means none; unknown IDs fail configuration
requirements.disabledProviders: An allowlist cannot enable a disabled host
requirements.customService: Require explicit opt-in and reject combining custom signup with a provider allowlist
requirements.existingAccounts: Discover the current host from the account handle or DID; signup choices do not constrain existing-account login
requirements.errors: Preserve user input, expose public error keys, and keep SDK errors and OAuth responses out of the UI
requirements.credentials: Keep passwords at the account host and authorization/session handling in a platform-specific adapter
requirements.navigation: The consuming app owns configured destinations; do not navigate using a query-string or state-supplied return URL
